statement: AI Render combines the active viewport with a text prompt or preset style to produce a photoreal image, overlaid as a scene.

source.ref: AI Render: generate image from viewport with prompt or preset

superiority: Geometry-faithful generation with a user-adjustable fidelity bound and a local-model option.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/using-ai-render Acceptance sketch: Same viewport and prompt give a render whose edges align with model silhouettes within 3 px (structure fidelity test).

statement: Preset styles and prompt guidance shape results; prompt strength controls prompt influence.

source.ref: AI Render: preset prompts and prompt engineering

notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/best-practices-custom-prompts Acceptance sketch: Same seed and prompt reproduces image within noise tolerance.

statement: Brush masks regenerate selected regions to erase, add or sketch elements.

source.ref: AI Render: in-painting masks (erase, add, sketch)

superiority: Non-destructive layered edits with a history of every mask pass.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/updating-ai-render Acceptance sketch: Mask a region and regenerate; pixels outside the mask are bit-identical to the prior image and pixels inside differ.

statement: A reference image defines stylistic output.

source.ref: AI Render: reference image for style

superiority: Multiple weighted style references, with the weights shown and editable.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Generate with a reference image; a style-similarity metric (Gram-matrix distance to the reference) is below a fixed threshold versus the no-reference baseline.

statement: Outputs are saved to a Gallery and can be shared or exported.

source.ref: AI Render: gallery, saving and sharing

superiority: Embeds prompt, seed and model version as metadata so any render can be reproduced.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/getting-started-ai-render Acceptance sketch: Save a result to the gallery, export it and compare file hashes; the exported image is bit-identical to the stored output.

statement: AI Render is available on desktop, web and iPad with platform-specific steps.

source.ref: AI Render: technical notes and platforms (desktop, web, iPad)

superiority: One shared pipeline across clients, with the model version recorded in each result.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/getting-started-ai-render Acceptance sketch: Run the same viewport, prompt and seed on desktop, web and iPad; outputs agree under SSIM 0.95.

statement: Help answers tool, workflow and best-practice questions in the app.
superiority: Answers cite help pages and can execute the command with confirmation.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/ai-assistant Acceptance sketch: Answer set evaluated on 100 questions with documented ground truth; accuracy threshold.

statement: Generate Object creates a 3D asset with PBR textures from a text prompt at a fixed credit cost.

source.ref: AI Assistant: Generate Object from text prompt

superiority: Editable, parametric output and local inference option.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/ai-generate Acceptance sketch: Generated object has valid manifold mesh and PBR maps; bounding box within the prompt dimensions when given.

statement: Generate Object from an image produces an object from a photo or sketch.

source.ref: AI Assistant: Generate Object from image

superiority: Multi-view fusion from several images for better backs and undersides.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Generated mesh silhouette from the input view overlaps the input image mask with IoU above 0.8, and the mesh is manifold with PBR maps.

superiority: Searchable, tagged gallery shared across the team with usage rights metadata.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Generate two objects, close the model, reopen the gallery; both are listed, previewable and importable into the model.

statement: AI features consume credits included monthly by plan (renamed Trimble Credits from 9 Nov 2026) with purchasable add-ons.

source.ref: Trimble Credits / AI credits and plans

notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/ai-features Acceptance sketch: Credit ledger decrements by the stated cost per operation.

statement: FAQ covers data use, ownership and availability.
superiority: Opt-in local processing so model data never leaves the machine.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Checklist of the documented data-use and ownership statements verified against the product UI text and settings.

statement: AI generates PBR materials from text or images.
superiority: Offline generation from local models and material capture from photos.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Generate a material from a prompt; the result contains base color, roughness, metalness and normal maps at matching resolution.

statement: A connector lets a Claude conversation generate .skp files from text, with groups and components, compatible with all SketchUp versions; it creates new files only.
superiority: Edits existing models and exposes the full scripting API to the assistant.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A text prompt for a 18 by 42 inch coffee table yields a .skp whose bounding box matches within 1 percent.

statement: Resources and extension for generating splats from images and video.
superiority: Native splat rendering inside the main viewport with section and clipping support.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/gaussian-splats-best-practices Acceptance sketch: Load a sample splat; splat count and bounds equal the file header and visibility toggles hide and show it.
